title: Multiplex Flat Input Schema
description: Schema for --flat mode input: a single implicit set of arg/val pairs, with no sets/include/cartesian-product semantics. Used by consumers (e.g. rickshaw's tool integration) that need validation/preset support but never need multiple values, sweeps, or included parameter groups.

items.description: A single flat parameter: an argument name and its one value.

val.description: The value for this parameter argument.

enabled.description: Controls whether this parameter is included. Defaults to 'yes' if not specified.
